about: E1 manifest: result files used by poc/analyze_e1_taxonomy.py, each with the run flags taken from the queue script that launched it (`source`, in poc/). seed = sampling seed; temperature/max_tokens as launched. Geometry toolbox: none = no helpers, K0 = needed helpers only, K8 = needed + 8 related extra helpers; head prelude = helpers pre-defined at execution. CO doc: none / full sheet / exact (problem-specific) snippet / near-miss (the CVRP snippet on VRPTW).
